visual_overrides.core_identity: A predatory mimic disguised as a treasure chest, revealing itself through a toothed lid-mouth, tongue, and organic seams.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Recognizable chest shape with lid lifted as an upper jaw and box body retained as the lower structure.
visual_overrides.head_features: No separate head; lid-mouth, irregular teeth, and long tongue emerge from the chest itself.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Wooden chest form flexes organically while hinges, boards, and treasure-box proportions remain obvious.
visual_overrides.surface: Minimal wood grain and simple fleshy reveal lines without heavy shading.
